fields.title: agent: spawn fails with '_modelRegistry.getApiKey is not a function' when agent type has no per-agent model config
fields.description:
Symptom
-------
Spawning an agent type that has no entry under settings.agents.<name> fails immediately with:

  amazon-bedrock/arn:aws:bedrock:us-east-1:284227543028:application-inference-profile/e4leivbxo36d: this._modelRegistry.getApiKey is not a function. (In 'this._modelRegistry.getApiKey(this.model)', 'this._modelRegistry.getApiKey' is undefined)

Status: state=failed, turns=0, toolCalls=0. The worker session never starts.

Repro
-----
1. ~/.pi/agent/settings.json:
   - defaultProvider: amazon-bedrock
   - defaultModel: <opus 4.7 inference profile ARN>
   - agents.{deep, smart, rush} configured explicitly
   - agents.finder / oracle / review / painter / librarian: NOT configured
2. From a tau-enabled session, call agent { action: spawn, agent: finder, message: ... }.
3. Agent fails with the error above.

Environment
-----------
- pi-ai 0.62.0, pi-agent-core 0.62.0, pi-coding-agent 0.62.0
- Bedrock auth via AWS SSO (~/.pi/agent/extensions/sso-refresh.ts), no API key in models.json
- AWS_PROFILE=cs-aidev, region us-east-1

Diagnosis
---------
- ModelRegistry from pi-coding-agent/dist/core/model-registry.js DOES have getApiKey(model) at line 422 (delegates to authStorage.getApiKey(model.provider)).
- AgentSession (pi-coding-agent/dist/core/agent-session.js:690, 1072, 1283, 1469, 2305) calls this._modelRegistry.getApiKey(this.model).
- The error says the method is undefined. Hypothesis: in the un-configured-agent fallback path, the value placed in _modelRegistry is either a plain object snapshot or a different shape (e.g., the raw pi-ai registry that exposes only getApiKeyForProvider).
- Smoking gun: configured agents (deep/smart/rush) work; only un-configured ones fail. Suggests fallback construction in tau (extensions/tau/src/agent/worker.ts ~line 197 / worker/lifecycle.ts ~line 71) builds a different registry shape when no explicit ModelSpec is provided.

Workaround
----------
Add explicit agents.{finder, oracle, review, painter, librarian} entries to settings.json pointing to existing Bedrock ARNs. This avoids the broken fallback path.

Acceptance
----------
- Spawning any built-in agent type with only defaultModel set in settings.json (no per-agent agents.<name> entry) succeeds and produces > 0 turns.
- Add a regression test that spawns each built-in agent type with a settings.json containing only defaultModel + defaultProvider.
- File: extensions/tau/src/agent/worker.ts and worker/lifecycle.ts.

Refs
----
- ~/.pi/agent/settings.json (currently lists only deep/smart/rush)
- ~/.pi/agent/models.json (3 Bedrock inference profiles, no apiKey)
- ~/.pi/agent/extensions/sso-refresh.ts (AWS SSO refresh, working)
